title: The Pilgrims' Feast
text: It is a feast day in the shrine town, and the tables run the length of the street, loaded with bread and roast meat and dark wine. The pilgrims share with anyone who has walked the road. Their feet are bandaged, their smiles fixed and bright.

options.label: Sit and eat with the pilgrims, and rest your feet among the faithful.

outcomes.text: Full, and among friends, and their fixed smiles hardly seem strange by the end.

options.label: Trade at the feast-day market while the town is in a generous mood.

outcomes.text: Good prices and good wares, and nobody asks where you have been.

options.label: The devout leads the feast in prayer, so the town remembers which House gave thanks.

outcomes.text: The town remembers your House, and says so loudly.
